description: Public transport accessibility indicators for Great Britain 2022 (PTAI-22) is a data set deposited in University of Glasgow by its authors Urban Big Data Centre. This is the first in a planned series of releases of this data product to reflect changes in transit schedules and location of services. Please note that this dataset is not a new version of the original PTAI data. It is a completely new data product based on new methodology and source datasets. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel, ZIP. Size stated: 1.5MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
